type: single-case practical pilot, sequential same assistant, not blinded
brief_pt: Encontrar abordagens de engenharia menos habituais para melhorar a descoberta do Bateia, além de busca semântica e ranking de repositórios; propor até três insights concretos, com fonte, adaptação e experimento de rejeição.
question_en: serendipitous software discovery beyond semantic search and repository ranking

direct_arm.method: adaptive web search and primary-source reading

bateia_arm.method: one fresh discover run; interpret only returned metadata/cards; no supplemental web search
bateia_arm.credentials: exclude tokens and dotenv from this pilot

limits: same assistant with prior project context; no independent evaluator
web and catalog APIs have different coverage/ranking and request units
direct results freeze before opening Bateia output
do not claim time/token/cost savings without measurement
no candidate code execution; evidence strength stays distinct from operational success
